sdk_change_rule: if the pinned SDK lacks session budget updates or agent updates, pin the first release that provides both and record the change as a correction before any trial
framing: contrast, not replication: no documented transition invalidates a live session

agent.system: Follow the user's output instruction exactly. Do not use tools.

work_unit: Return exactly 120 repetitions of the token ALPHA, separated by one space, and nothing else.
wait_rule: after each work event, require a session.status_idle event ordered after the sent event and an idle session status; after each budget or agent update, require the update to be echoed before more work

amendments.change: work-unit bound after each transition raised from 20 to 40; classification thresholds unchanged
amendments.reason: the earlier pilot reached its first reported cent after two or three work units, so the four cents remaining after the agent-update transition can need about twenty units and the original bound would misclassify conforming trials

pilot.continue_rule: median work units per reported cent is at least 2

order: all 30 cell trials shuffled together with random_seed

lowered_cap_carries_spend.then: repeat work units until budget_reached, at most work_unit_bound_after_transition
lowered_cap_carries_spend.measure: added_cents = final reported cents - reported cents at update
lowered_cap_carries_spend.post_budget_probe: a user.message must be refused with HTTP 400

prediction.message: budget.max_list_cost must be greater than the session's consumed list cost

agent_update_leaves_live_session.agent_update: change the agent description; the returned version must be the previous version plus one
agent_update_leaves_live_session.then: repeat work units until budget_reached, at most work_unit_bound_after_transition

classification.pinned_and_retained: session still references the original agent version and final reported cents <= 7

eligibility.nonconforming_trials: retain and report; never replace or omit
nonconforming_conditions: session status terminated or rescheduling during a scored step
stop_when: more than two nonconforming trials in one cell

cleanup: delete every session with a typed not-found proof, archive every agent, delete the environment
